statement: Nvidia scaled back its financial guarantee for the planned OpenAI data-center campus in Ohio from a proposed $250 billion to less than $120 billion, covering only the first phase.
why: Vendor balance-sheet backstops have been a key enabler of marginal-buyer AI compute build-outs, so a much smaller guarantee tightens the financing behind committed GPU deployments.

impact.mechanism: A reduced Nvidia backstop shifts more of the Ohio campus financing onto third parties, which can slow or shrink the committed GPU build-out at that site.

evidence.source: Yahoo Finance (citing Wall Street Journal reporting)
evidence.excerpt: Nvidia has revised its financial commitment to a planned OpenAI data-center campus in Ohio

confidence.basis: Single secondary outlet relaying Wall Street Journal and Reuters reporting; no primary filing or company statement.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> falling); sources: Nvidia Newsroom (official), Yahoo Finance (citing Wall Street Journal reporting)
